content_blocks.text: The normal workflow is source file → compiler → class file → JVM execution. Compilation errors are reported before the program runs; runtime exceptions and logical mistakes require different debugging approaches. items.title: Evaluating expressions
items.text: Use Path and Files for modern file operations, choose byte or character APIs based on the data, and close resources reliably. Parse external files defensively because their contents may be incomplete or malformed.

items.title: Declaring variables interactively
items.text: A variable has a declared type and a scope. Initialize local variables before reading them; fields have defined default values, but relying on defaults can hide missing business logic.
